app.name: CavEX: Re-Crafted Edition
app.short_description: Blocky survival and building for the Wii
app.long_description: Blocky survival and building for the Wii that plays like Beta 1.7.3. Fully playable with a Wii Remote + Nunchuk, a Classic Controller or a GameCube controller. Single player, local split-screen, and online play on Beta 1.7.3 servers. Built on CavEX by xtreme8000 and fCavEX. Not affiliated with Mojang or Nintendo. Full credits are in the NOTICE file.
